name: Tortuga Bay
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive resort designed by Oscar de la Renta feels more like a private estate than a hotel, with only 30 suites scattered across pristine beachfront.
whats_special: Tortuga Bay is the only resort in the Dominican Republic designed by a fashion legend. Oscar de la Renta's sophisticated aesthetic shines through Mediterranean-inspired architecture, while the property sits on one of Punta Cana's most secluded stretches of white sand. Each suite features a private terrace and direct beach access, creating an intimate sanctuary within the larger Puntacana Resort & Club.
pro_tip: Book the beachfront suites on the northern end for the most privacy and stunning sunrise views over the turquoise Caribbean waters.
dont_miss: The resort's exclusive access to Juanillo Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches, and the nearby Puntacana Resort's championship golf courses designed by Tom Fazio. The intimate Bamboo restaurant serves exceptional farm-to-table cuisine using ingredients from the resort's own organic garden.
pros: Exclusive Oscar de la Renta-designed luxury villas with private pools
Pristine private beach with crystal-clear Caribbean waters
World-class golf course designed by Pete Dye
Exceptional personalized service with dedicated villa hosts
cons: Limited villa inventory requires advance booking
